params.name: name
params.description: What the skill is called: the name of its folder where an agent is given it. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit. Another skill's name is refused with a message.

params.name: text
params.description: Its `SKILL.md`. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: files
params.description: Other files of the skill, each by its path in the skill's folder. Absent: none.

errors.message: The name cannot be a folder's or is another skill's, the SKILL.md is blank, or a file's path is not a relative path in the skill's folder (absolute, with `..`, `\` or an empty part, `SKILL.md` itself, or another file's).

methods.name: _update_skill
methods.summary: Change a skill. An agent given it before keeps the copy it was given.

params.name: name
params.description: What the skill is called, as `_add_skill` takes it.

params.name: text
params.description: Its `SKILL.md`. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: files
params.description: Its other files, in place of the ones it has. Absent: none.

errors.message: There is no such skill, or what is given is refused as `_add_skill` refuses it.

methods.name: _remove_skill
methods.summary: Remove a skill. An agent given it before keeps the copy it was given; an app that asks for it by name is told there is no such skill.

methods.name: list_skills
methods.description: The skills the Skills app keeps, by name: what each is called (the name of its folder) and what it is for (the `description` of its SKILL.md's front matter; empty when it has none). An app that runs agents offers them to choose from, and asks for one with `get_skill`.

methods.name: get_skill
methods.description: One skill, by its name: its SKILL.md and the other files of its folder, each by its path there. A name that is no skill's fails, and says so.

params.name: name
params.description: What the skill is called, as `list_skills` gives it

errors.message: There is no skill of that name.

SkillFile.description: A file of a skill besides its SKILL.md.

path.description: Where it is in the skill's folder, with `/` between its parts (`scripts/check.sh`).

Skill.description: A skill: a folder an agent is given, with its SKILL.md and other files.

name.description: What it is called, and the name of its folder.

description.description: The `description` of its SKILL.md's front matter; empty when it has none.

SkillSummary.description: A skill as another app lists it: what it is called, which is the name of its folder, and what it is for.

description.description: The `description` of its SKILL.md's front matter; empty when it has none.

SkillText.description: A skill as another app is given it, to copy where its agent reads it: a folder of its name, holding its SKILL.md and its other files.
